findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_kommo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kommo_talks_list, kommo_talks_get · Private data: kommo_contacts_list, kommo_contacts_get, kommo_contacts_create, kommo_contacts_update, kommo_custom_fields, kommo_request, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kommo_talks_list, kommo_talks_get · Private data: kommo_contacts_list, kommo_contacts_get, kommo_contacts_create, kommo_contacts_update, kommo_custom_fields, kommo_request, connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: report_bug · Destructive: marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
